claim.quote: The DAMA signal region for both spin independent and spin dependent interactions for the WIMP mass higher than 20 GeV/c^2are excluded by the single experiment with crystal scintillators.

name: Limits on WIMP-nucleon interactions with CsI(Tl) crystal detectors

summary.plain: With 3409 kg-days from four crystals, KIMS excluded the DAMA signal region for WIMPs heavier than 20 GeV (spin-independent and spin-dependent) and set the best limit then on spin-dependent interactions with protons.
summary.technical: 3409 kg d with four CsI(Tl) crystals at 0 C; abstract: 'The most stringent limit on the spin dependent interaction for pure proton case is obtained' and the DAMA signal regions for WIMP masses above 20 GeV/c^2 are excluded (Phys. Rev. Lett. 99, 091301 (2007)). The abstract speaks of 'the DAMA signal', not of DAMA/LIBRA.

title: Limits on WIMP-nucleon interactions with CsI(Tl) crystal detectors
why_it_matters: The abstract states that the DAMA signal region is excluded by a single crystal-scintillator experiment (CsI(Tl), a different target from DAMA's NaI(Tl)).
